_comment: Seccomp deny-overlay for services that have no business touching the kernel keyring: makes add_key/request_key/keyctl fail with EPERM, which breaks Keyringer/Dntry-class stash loaders at phase 1. Use as a Docker/containerd seccomp profile for daemons (default-allow profile with three errno'd syscalls). For maximum-strictness hosts, prefer a default-allowlist profile instead. Load: docker run --security-opt seccomp=keyringer-deny.seccomp.json ... or merge into an existing profile.
